metadata.title: Rigidity theorems of complete self-shrinkers in the Euclidean space
metadata.abstract: We classify complete Lagrangian self-shrinking surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^{4}$ with constant squared norm of the mean curvature vector, without assuming an upper bound for the second fundamental form. Their images are a plane through the origin, the round cylinder $S^1(1)\times \mathbb{R}$, or the Clifford torus $S^1(1)\times S^1(1)$. More generally, a complete self-shrinking surface in $\mathbb{R}^{4}$ with constant $|\vec{H}|^2$ is either a plane, a round cylinder, or a complete minimal immersion into $S^3(\sqrt2)$. The proof uses the function $|x|^2-|\vec{H}|^2$, the Bochner formula, and completeness.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 分类 R⁴ 中平均曲率向量长度平方恒定的完备自收缩曲面，特别处理 Lagrangian 情形。
analysis.breakthrough: Lagrangian 情形仅有过原点平面、圆柱和 Clifford 环面，且不预设第二基本形式上界；一般情形还允许 S³(√2) 中的完备极小浸入。
analysis.limitations: 是曲面及 R⁴ 中的结论；一般情形的球面极小浸入不能误缩为仅 Clifford 环面。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 删除第二基本形式上界后仍获得清晰分类。
